scope: Native Rust before/after CPU optimization; stage diagnostics and retained pipeline version are separate. No new C# performance comparison.

baseline.label: frozen 577db45 production sources plus diagnostic harness

diagnostic_v1.label: unconditional kernel policy comparisons; not final production dispatch

retained.label: bounded 9x9 dispatch, ARM threshold and shared graph indexes

source_fingerprint_recipe: SHA256 of Python json.dumps(file_sha256_mapping, sort_keys=True).encode(); mappings cover src/examples/tools plus Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml; exclude target paths and docs. Raw source manifests preserved without recomputing or merging versions. For a delta version, copy file_delta_from files, remove removed_files, then apply changed_or_added_files to reconstruct the exact full mapping.
result_fingerprint_recipe: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(parsed_owned_result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)); OCR text/geometry payload omitted here, preserved in linked raw worker JSON. output_exact compares the complete parsed owned results.
path_note: Paths are repository-relative where possible. raw_job_sha256 hashes the archived original job bytes, which contain local absolute paths; normalized job representations here are descriptive.

provenance.policy: One warmup and three measured runs per case; native release builds; serial measurement; 60 seconds performance execution per version excluding builds; preserve all fixed samples.

arm_depthwise.sample_order: ABC, CBA, ABC; one warmup for each policy before sampling
arm_depthwise.decision: retain bounded strips only for 9x9, cout>=256, unit stride/dilation, oh>=64, ow>=64; reject 7x7 and full-row heap scratch

threshold.sample_order: original/deferred/packed/selected, rotating start by one policy per sample
threshold.decision: Selected ARM SIMD byte narrowing retained; packed table and deferred-only controls remain test-only; x86 production unchanged

physical_plan_bind.timed_scope: Plan::bind and result drop, including fixed metadata assertions; exclude model load/compile/weight packing/logical shape propagation/activation allocation

diagnostic_v1.production_dispatch_warning: These are forced policy comparisons under diagnostic_v1 source, not a benchmark of the final production dispatch. Retained pipeline results below validate the final source separately.

retained_changes.name: ARM64 bounded depthwise strips
retained_changes.dispatch: 9x9, cout>=256, sh=sw=dh=dw=1, oh>=64, ow>=64, with existing NEON/depthwise/packed-span validation
retained_changes.preserves: ordered KY/KX FMA, bias first, scalar MUL/ADD tails, partial bands, padding and fused global store indices

retained_changes.name: shared graph use indexes
retained_changes.compiled_metadata: CSR consumer indexes (including duplicate operands) and producer indexes shared by CompiledModel Arc
retained_changes.preserves: prefix-aware exclusivity, selected outputs, shape-specific fusion legality, reserved gapped semantic members and normalized tracing

retained_changes.name: ARM threshold SIMD mask narrowing
retained_changes.mechanism: retain validity/any masks in SIMD registers and narrow comparison lanes directly to bitmap bytes
retained_changes.preserves: strict greater-than semantics, finite-input rejection and scalar tails

final_pipeline.protocol: one first batch, one warmup, three measured batches; balanced version order; serialized; 60s aggregate execution per version; native release/default features; macOS unbound
final_pipeline.interpretation: Medium sparse median 391.07175 to 368.470959 ms (5.78% lower), disjoint sampled ranges; Tiny sparse 0.84% lower with disjoint sampled ranges, small magnitude. Other latency cells and all throughput cells overlap; no general pipeline speedup claim.

validation.clippy_warnings: Existing architecture/harness warnings plus three benign new diagnostic-style warnings (constant release assertion and range-indexed sample loops); not warning-free. Measured source frozen without subsequent lint edits.

limits: One physical Apple M4; unbound macOS scheduling; one warmup and three fixed samples per case.
Disjoint sampled ranges do not establish statistical significance or steady state.
Only nine latency and three concurrent-throughput cells measured; no serial pipeline or full platform performance matrix.
Kernel and planning improvements do not imply comparable whole-pipeline savings.
No native x86 or other ARM CPU performance validation.
